rows.note: Use 按摩 as the all-purpose noun for body massage.

example.english: Having a massage after exercising is great for relaxing the muscles.
example.traditional: 運動完做吓按摩，對放鬆肌肉好有幫助。
example.jyutping: wan6 dung6 jyun4 zou6 haa5 on3 mo1 deoi3 fong3 sung1 gei1 juk6 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6

rows.note: Use 𢱕骨 for the colloquial expression for getting a massage, especially a full-body or therapeutic one.

example.english: My whole body aches, so I’m going for a massage tonight.
example.traditional: 我成身痠痛，今晚去𢱕骨先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sing4 san1 syun1 tung3 gam1 maan1 heoi3 dap6 gwat1 sin1
